title: Pipeline status file
description: The machine-readable definition of docs/PIPELINE-CONTRACT.md §16 — the one file the status job (scripts/pipeline_status_local.py) writes each pass: each plan's pieces, each piece's pull requests, their merge state, the required checks the job's config names, and the newest Stage E review of each. The tech lead, the daily summaries and the GitHub-only pages read it instead of holding a GitHub token (KIT-306, path A).
$comment: FIELDS ONLY. Every value is an id, a cleaned title, a state from a closed list, a count, a time or a link. No pull request, comment or review text reaches this file, and no pull request title: the ticket's title names the piece. A cleaned title is one line, at most 120 characters, with no angle bracket, ampersand, pipe, backtick or control character, so it can be quoted anywhere as data.

schema.description: The marker. A reader that does not know it refuses the file; it does not guess.

written_at.description: When this pass wrote the file. Its age is the answer to "how old is this?": the heartbeat monitor judges it stale by this field.

result.description: `ok`: every source was read. `partial`: at least one source was not read whole, and `sources` says which and why. `failed`: no source that is on could be read; the job exits 1.

error.description: Null, unless the pass stopped on an unexpected error: then one line saying why, and every source that is on is could-not-read. A pass cut short by its clock or a cap is partial, and the source's reason says so.

lookback_hours.description: A plan finished within this many hours is still listed, so a day's summary can say what shipped.

sources.description: One entry per source this job reads.

tracker.description: Linear: the plans, their pieces, and the pull requests the GitHub integration linked to each.

github.description: GitHub: each pull request's state, merge state and check runs.

reviews.description: The review poller's outcome records on this machine: each pull request's newest Stage E review.

counts.description: Totals over `plans`, so a quiet day can say what was checked.

plans.description: Each plan the idea gate filed, open or finished within `lookback_hours`. Empty when the tracker could not be read: `sources.tracker` then says so.

other_pull_requests.description: KIT-487. Each open pull request in a repository `required_checks` names by key that no listed plan's piece links to, read the same way as a plan's. Optional: a file from before KIT-487 has none, and a reader that does not know it keeps working.

other_pull_requests_complete.description: KIT-487. true: every such repository's open pull requests were listed. false: at least one was not, or there were more than 200, and `sources.github` says why. null: no repository is named by key, so none was looked for. An empty list is "none open" only when this is true.

findings.description: The heartbeat monitor's view of `sources`: one entry per source not read whole, in the health watch's words, so the monitor can read this file as it reads that watch's.

firing.description: Empty unless `result` is `failed`: then the sources that could not be read, which the heartbeat monitor pages on.

title.description: Cleaned: one line, at most 120 characters, with no angle bracket, ampersand, pipe, backtick, or control, format or other hidden character.

state_type.description: The tracker's own kind of state; `unknown` when it named none this job knows.

state.description: `read`: every question asked was answered. `partly-read`: some were not, and `reason` names the first. `could-not-read`: none was, or it could not be asked; `reason` says why. `off`: this job is configured not to read it.

asked.description: Questions this pass put to the source: tracker queries; GitHub requests (the probe, each pull request, each check-run listing); review records looked for.

answered.description: How many of them it answered. A review record that does not exist is an answer: no review yet.

reason.description: Why it was not read whole; null when it was, or when it is off.

read_at.description: When this pass last had an answer from it; null when it had none.

state.description: The state's name in the tracker, cleaned.

pieces_complete.description: False when the plan has more children than one read holds, so a piece may be missing.

flags.description: The lifecycle labels on the ticket, from a closed list (contract §6). Any other label is left out.

prs_complete.description: False when the ticket has more links than one read holds, so a pull request may be missing.

session.description: KIT-449, optional, open pieces only: the piece's newest agent session, null when it has none. `unknown` (with id null) when the session listing could not be read whole, never null.

source.description: `github`: GitHub answered this pass. `tracker`: it did not, and `state` is what the tracker's link says; `error` says why.

error.description: Why GitHub was not read for this pull request, or for its check runs; null when both were.

head_sha.description: The head commit, cut to 12 characters.

mergeable.description: `conflicting`: GitHub cannot merge it as it is. `unknown`: GitHub has not worked it out, or was not read.

merge_state.description: GitHub's own word for why it can or cannot merge, or null when GitHub was not read.

labels.description: Pipeline labels on the pull request, from a closed list: `conflict` (the conflict loop's) and `hooks-change` (the owner's).

conflict_gave_up.description: KIT-448, optional: the conflict episode the conflict loop gave up on (an `escalated` or `page` marker by github-actions[bot]) while the pull request is still conflicting; null when it has not, or it no longer conflicts.

union_red.description: KIT-448, optional: the newest red verdict of the union check that names this pull request (a `pr-union:red` marker by github-actions[bot]), by its key. A later green verdict posts nothing, so this can outlive the red. Null when there is none.

result.description: `passing`: every named check passed. `failing`: one that does not wait on a person failed. `pending`: one is running or has not started. `waiting`: only checks that wait on a person are not passing. `none`: the config names no check for this repository. `unknown`: the checks were not read.

required.description: Each check the config names for this repository, in its order.

state.description: `missing`: no run of that name on the head commit. `unknown`: the runs were not read.

waits_on_person.description: True for a check only a person turns green, such as the hooks-change label's guard.

state.description: `none`: no review on record. `clean`: reviewed, nothing found. `notes`: findings below the threshold. `findings`: findings at or above it. `partial`: whole files were withheld from the reviewer and nothing it saw met the threshold, so a person reviews the rest; never clean. `not-reviewed`: the reviewer could not judge it. `unknown`: the record could not be read, or reviews are not read here.

findings.description: How many findings, never what they say.

current.description: True when the review judged the pull request's current head; null when either head is unknown.

state.description: `unknown` does not page; `firing` does, and only on a `failed` pass.
